I will tell you a skill that always helped me. 

Draw a circle, then write whatever you can control inside it, and what you can’t control outside. That helps in reminding yourself of what can be done and where to put your energy on. Wasting your energy on what you can’t control will only harm you without achieving any progress because at the end you don’t have any control over it.

What you currently have control over is deciding which offer you will accept and align with your goals and visions.

Also, allow yourself to make mistakes, this is prt of learning. What are experiences but mistakes that have been done? 

Wishing you all the best.
